subject: Runtime role backfill & comp-band confirmation
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@talentpartners.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Runtime role backfill & comp-band confirmation

Team —

Quick context: An IC on our runtime infra team (backend services) submitted notice last week; they are on a three-week transition plan. The role is a mission-critical backend/runtime engineer (low-latency inference stack). I ran a short impact analysis (attached) and recommend we backfill the headcount immediately and proceed with an internal comp-band that aligns to Senior SWE (band 4).

Asks:
- Approve backfill now (headcount already budgeted in Q4 runtime slate).
- Confirm comp band: proposal attached suggests band 4 / comp midpoint aligned to existing runtime bench.
- If approved, request permission to engage Alicia to accelerate candidate outreach and to issue target offer band once comp is confirmed.

Why now: losing this seat would leave two services with single-owner rotations and increase oncall risk through December. We also have a candidate in the pipeline (referred) who can interview next week — Alicia is on the thread.

Attachments: JD_Runtime_Infrastructure_Engineer_2026.pdf, backfill-headcount-impact-brief.pdf, comp-band-proposal-2026.xlsx

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Sr. Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@talentpartners.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime role backfill & comp-band confirmation

Thanks Rachel — solid write-up. A couple of quick questions before I sign off:

1) Can you confirm the expected oncall coverage delta (hours/week) if we do not fill by Nov 15? Your brief references "rotation risk" but I want a concrete number for ops planning.
2) The comp-band sheet shows band 4 midpoint at $220k total cash; is there flexibility to push to the top of band if the candidate has rare infra + systems experience?

I am inclined to approve the headcount immediately, pending Karthik's compensation sign-off. If Karthik OKs the band and payroll confirms offer plumbing, Markus can greenlight outreach to the referral.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@talentpartners.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T13:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime role backfill & comp-band confirmation

Rachel / Markus —

I reviewed the impact brief and comp-band spreadsheet. I'm supportive of the headcount backfill; operational risk seems material. A couple of administrative notes before final approval:

- Please confirm the job posting will reflect band 4 and list the target total cash range (midpoint ± 10%) so offers stay within expected limits.
- We need an explicit note in the offer memo if we plan to go above band midpoint (Markus's ask). That requires VP written approval for exceptions; Markus, a reply confirming is fine.
- If Alicia will be sourcing, please have the recruiter collect salary expectations before scheduling onsite interviews to avoid later redlines.

Assuming Markus OKs the comp top-band flexibility and Karthik signs the final band, you have my approval to proceed. I'll ask People Ops to hold a tentative headcount slot for the team through the end of the month.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@talentpartners.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T17:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime role backfill & comp-band confirmation

Rachel / team —

Thanks for the thorough packet. Answers inline:

- Ops delta: Without a backfill through Nov 15, we estimate an additional 6–8 hours/week of redistributed oncall work per remaining engineer across the runtime team (conservative). That's consistent with Rachel's brief.
- Comp band: I approve band 4 as the baseline. For exceptional infra/systems candidates, I'm authorizing up to the top of band 4 (not beyond) with written rationale in the offer memo. If you want to go to band 5 you must route an exception to exec comp committee.

Rachel — you have approval to engage Alicia and proceed with outreach. Alicia, please confirm candidate availability for interviews and collect salary expectations. We'll aim to have an offer out within 10 business days of final interviews.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Infrastructure & Runtime
Redwood Inference
